## Method notes

- Predictions recovered from bits: wrong -> flipped label (an unparseable '?' answer is indistinguishable from a flip in the bitmap).
- Holm family = (comparison, n, model, seed) across tasks; p_holm_tasks_x_seeds also pools seeds into the family (more conservative).
- Bootstrap: seeds and items resampled with replacement; items shared across seeds.
